verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP API server for external access to the graph. A single POST /api endpoint dispatches any plugin-API method (logseq.Editor, logseq.DB, and others) with bearer-token auth and a worked write example (logseq.Editor.insertBlock), so an agent can read and write notes programmatically. However, the server must be enabled from the desktop app's Features menu, and evidence only shows it running as part of the app, so a truly GUI-free headless setup is not demonstrated. missing for 10: evidence it runs without the desktop GUI or GUI setup, an explicit documented read example, an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probes 404), an official MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent read/write use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent or assistant can read AND write my notes headlessly — through a documented local API, vendor API, or MCP server — without me touching the GUI
